source_text: Quam pulchra tabernacula tua Iacob. Mysterium ecclesiae ordinatae; gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: How beautiful tents your Jacob. Mystery of-church ordered; glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[How fair are your tents, O Jacob >> Bible:Numbers 24:5]] — a mystery of the ordered church. Glory forever. Amen.
